```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Make the project root the working directory, so paths like "data/..." work
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
set.seed(123)   # reproducibility
```

# 1. Load packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(skimr)
library(naniar)
library(corrplot)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
```

# 2. Import data

```{r import}
raw <- read_excel("data/dataset-uci.xlsx")
dim(raw)
```

# 3. Data cleaning

## 3.1 Standardise names and convert variable types

```{r clean-and-types}
df <- raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    # Target: per UCI documentation 0 = gallstones present, 1 = absent
    gallstone_status = factor(gallstone_status, levels = c(0, 1),
                              labels = c("Gallstone", "No_gallstone")),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    across(c(coronary_artery_disease_cad, hypothyroidism,
             hyperlipidemia, diabetes_mellitus_dm),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")))
  )

glimpse(df)
table(df$gallstone_status)
```
## 3.2 Quality checks

```{r quality}
# Total missing values in the whole dataset (expected: 0)
sum(is.na(df))

# Duplicate rows (expected: 0)
sum(duplicated(df))

# Summary of every variable: check the min and max of each one
summary(df)
```

## 3.3 Save the cleaned dataset

```{r save-clean}
write_csv(df, "data/gallstone_clean.csv")
```

## 3.3 Age and other range checks

```{r boxplots, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
df |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5,
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(22)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Distribution of numeric variables") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

## 3.4 Inspect suspicious values

```{r suspicious}
df |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  filter(obesity_percent > 150 |
         high_density_lipoprotein_hdl > 150 |
         muscle_mass_mm < 20 |
         total_body_water_tbw < 20 |
         glomerular_filtration_rate_gfr < 20 |
         low_density_lipoprotein_ldl < 30) |>
  select(row_id, age, gender, gallstone_status, weight,
         body_mass_index_bmi, obesity_percent, muscle_mass_mm,
         total_body_water_tbw, high_density_lipoprotein_hdl,
         low_density_lipoprotein_ldl, creatinine,
         glomerular_filtration_rate_gfr)
```
